title: Ivo
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Eruvin 36b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.36b.9): Rav said, “Our Mishnah is not [authoritative], since Ivo taught [otherwise].” Hyman reports that [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Eruvin.36b.9.3) there explains that Ivo was a sage.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage names Ayo (איו), rendered Ivo here. Rashi glosses it as the name of a sage. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=414&lang=en) cites additional occurrences and a separate remark attributed to Ulla.
